title: Meet the Filipina writer who co-wrote New York Times bestselling graphic novel
summary: For Filipina writer Mikki Crisostomo, who co-wrote 'The Long-Lived King,' seeing her name on a book in a bookstore on its release day was an emotional milestone that left her in awe.
